newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX ends up 1.17 pct at new closing high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX ends up 1.17 pct at new closing high.

text.p: Austrian shares end at record closing high up 1.17 pct at 1,406.34. Traders forecast further gains due to dollar strength and low interest rates. Next target seen 1,450 points.
* 13 gainers outweigh seven losers, one unchanged
* Top gainer AMS, up 6.45 pct at 1,155 ats
* Top loser Lenzing, down 0.41 pct at 727 ats
* July ATX future up 24.0 at 1,415.6 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
